offering_description.value: The company provides regional, long-haul and dedicated truckload transportation for business shippers. It uses regionally based drivers and a nationwide network of operating centers to handle local shuttles and longer routes.

quotes.quote: With operating centers located in key markets nation-wide, our regional operations serve the short to medium haul needs of shippers (see who we serve), ranging from local shuttle operations to one or two day transits. Loads are executed by regionally based drivers, customer service, dispatch managers, and shop maintenance facilities.

These specialized divisions allow us to provide continuous service on long length of haul loads to the West Coast and the Northwest, as well as other regions. We also provide dedicated tour or round-trip oriented service in various markets nation-wide.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial shippers including food distributors, consumer goods companies, manufacturers and retailers

quotes.quote: Heartland Express customers represent the most successful businesses in the world. The top shippers in America depend on Heartland Express to improve business performance, deliver exceptional results to their customers, and drive overall value into their transportation supply chain.

Heartland Express brings together industry experience, state of the art equipment and technology, and good people with a vision to be the best, to serve the truckload transportation needs of the top shippers in America. Our services improve the daily lives of people by moving goods and supplies to where they are needed, to the super-market shelves, to the manufacturing production lines, to the home improvement stores in our communities.
